_readme: Copy this to .miku/mcp.json and set MIKU_MCP_ENABLED=true. Both are needed:
the file alone does nothing, and the flag alone is not an error.
.miku/ is gitignored, which is where the real file belongs -- a server
description carries the credentials that server is started with.
Run `uv sync --extra mcp` first, then `uv run miku mcp` to see what connected.
JSON has no comments, so this key is the documentation. It is ignored.

servers.name: echo
servers._note: The in-repo fixture. No npx, no network, no credentials -- the one entry here that works on a fresh clone.

servers.name: chrome
servers._note: Offers 29 tools, measured. Miku has 4. 'tools' is an allowlist, and omitting it binds all 29 -- which is why this entry names three.

servers.name: employees
servers._note: A server in its own project, with its own interpreter and relative imports. 'cwd' is what makes this expressible at all.
